description: Information security program plan is not developed, documented, or maintained at the organization level. This signal indicates that the organization may lack a comprehensive, organization-wide security program plan that establishes the foundation for managing security risk across all organizational systems and operations.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) pursuing FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies managing information systems Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs) conducting assessments Federal information systems processing, storing, or transmitting federal data Organizations supporting federal cloud services

metadata.detection_notes: Detection of this signal typically involves: Review of organization-wide information security program plan documentation Analysis of program plan scope, covering all organizational operations and assets Verification of roles, responsibilities, and accountability assignments Assessment of security program management controls and common controls Examination of coordination mechanisms across organizational entities Review of senior official approval and authority Verification of annual review and update processes Assessment of program plan alignment with organizational mission and risk tolerance The presence of this signal indicates a condition that warrants review in the context of FedRAMP program management requirements.

sources.title: FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
